title: Conversion to a query-learning program
statement: For each dimension $n$ and output type, every deterministic program whose queries are points of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and whose answers are signs can be represented as a query-learning program with the same output type. Each finite batch of inputs is queried against the target, and the program continues using the resulting labels; charged local computation steps are retained.
